cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(rc_car_description)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)

# meshes/ is generated by tools/build_urdf.py (it stages the STLs out of
# Hardware/Mechanical) and MUST be installed: the URDF refers to them by
# package://rc_car_description/meshes/..., so without this an installed
# package has dead mesh references.
install(
  DIRECTORY urdf launch config meshes
  DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}
)

ament_package()
